findings.title: Boundary conditions shape rule
findings.claim: The exposed eastern people make the focus part of a rule pattern in which reach meets different material exposure, moral conduct, and degrees of knowledge, so response takes its form from the condition encountered.
findings.mechanism: The western endpoint supplies spring, sunset, punishment, good action, matching recompense, and ease; the eastern focus supplies sunrise on a people without a screen, while 18:91 supplies encompassing knowledge. These carriers return through the focus people, sun, rising, and screen words and turn the endpoint into a condition-sensitive response scene.
findings.reader_payoff: The missing screen becomes part of a larger contrast between an endpoint's conditions and the form of response, rather than an isolated climate detail.
findings.containment: The focus still plainly reports a people under the rising sun without a made screen. The macro relation adds calibrated governance and informed observation; it does not claim that the focus alone states a general political rule or that every endpoint has the same response.

epistemic.reason: The channel support, exact context ayat, and focus-direction connection rows are trusted and land each nominated branch on a supplied occurrence.
